title: TCL 98" C8L 4K Mini LED TV (2026) $4790 + Del ($0 to Select Areas) @ Appliance Central (Ex. TAS) ($4290 Price Beat at JB Hi-Fi)
body:
Deal: TCL 98" C8L 4K Mini LED TV (2026) $4790 + Del ($0 to Select Areas) @ Appliance Central (Ex. TAS) ($4290 Price Beat at JB Hi-Fi)

[AryaTheExplorer] ATL for C8L I think. Been eyeing this for a long time but it's so hard to justify paying almost double compared to a 85inch just for 33% more viewing area.
85inch is on back order from AC so JB refused to price match it.
[thanq] Nice well down.
Getting close to where id pull the trigger.
[Jackson] There's a cheaper 98" isn't there? Is this mini led?
[SpendMoreNow] Yes there are cheaper 98. As low as $2K. But this is a top tier TV with SQD mini LED backlight and good speakers.
[skysurfer] "If you have a viewing distance < 3.5m, I would not recommend it for longer viewings as you might end up playing ping pong with your eyes. > 4.5 m should be comfortable. In between do your research."
I have a projector with 130 inch screen at 4 metres and the whole family loves it. No friends have ever said its too large either. Just balancing your opinion so people dont decide what size they should get based on it. Best way is to test for yourself and watch for a minimum of half an hour preferably longer because its very common that people wish they'd gone bigger after having what they thought was big at home for a while.
[SpendMoreNow] I mentioned for longer viewings. For a movie night < 3.5m its ok. It gives you cinematic feel. But if you watch a lot of tv regularly it can strain your eyes if viewing distance is not suitable for TV size.
of course everyones preference differs but there are guidelines if you want to play safe.
https://www.rtings.com/tv/reviews/by-size/size-to-distance-r…
[Jackson] Those size and distances a total bollocks. You can watch it at whatever distance you feel like. I don't know how came up with these but they seemed to only exist to make people feel like they had a big enough tv when they didnt
[BusMan247] I agree with your sentiment. Viewing distance is totally personal. This age of people telling you what you like ls a bit absurd.
[OzeePlay] @BusMan247: True. I have 100" UST VAVA 4K projector, and viewing at 3.75m is so much fun!!!! I am just now thinking to upgrade UST (5 year old), and TV in similar price range is now serious contender.
[liam2040] Or the opposite … the graph is telling me i should be 1.67m from my 55" when watching movies.
[team teri] I for my part am very happy you included the additional info. Thanks for going to the effort OP!
Question for the crowd: not wanting to spend more than $2k, what model TV to keep an eye on for best value for money?
Probably 85". Realistically, the room isn't suited for 98. And no rush, the current 75" TCL will do us for as long as it takes to find a bargain, boxing day 2027 would still be fine ;-)
[SpendMoreNow] In TCL, same model in 85" if you are happy to wait it out a year or so. One model lower, C7L if you want it sooner.
Hisense provides good competition but I don't know exact models. I usually find difficult to find good bargains in LG Sony and Samsung.
I would stay away from cheaper brands like Kogan Aldi etc.
Use Chatgpt or other AI as a starting point if you are not much into TV terminology and want to compare models in layman's terms.
[ClioB] You can grab a Hisense 85" u7s for $1500 + delivery from JB hi-fi by price matching appliance central and applying the $500 off voucher. I think it's very hard deal to beat bang for buck wise. I've just been to JB and saw both of them, the tcl picture looks more impressive to me, but it could be the sample video played etc… not sure myself
[OzeePlay] IMO, $2200-2500 is sweet spot to grab 85 C8L whenever it comes. I would take always 85" over 75" and if possible to hang it on a wall. TCL gives value for money, and you will be happy to upgrade every 3-5 years:) ; I personally wouldn't wait beyond boxing day or EOFY deal for the latest model. I have 85C855 , and bought it based on ozbargainers reviews only. I am glad I upraded from older 65" TCL. My theatre room projector is less used now though it has better dedicated sound system. I have paired my 85C855 with Samsung 990F soundbar system for living room setup and going great.
[team teri] You might be right. Seeing it was $2750 already (HN with $250 gift card), it will come down to $2500 or below on Black Friday. Combine with some discounted gift cards and it should be close enough to convince the lady of the house :-)
Edit: well, it would have been today, price matching Appliance Central at JB and then applying the $500 off from this - if I had been better prepared. Oh well, it will come back :-)
[Royale with cheese] I got 98 C8K this year in March for $3750. Used giftcards and store credits. I think overall costed me $3300 or less. But yes it was almost out of stock by then and had to wait a while for the delivery.
[cnut] Unfortunately we have been informed to include the coupon pricing in the price match as competitor don't offer the same coupon deal
Bummer.
[SpendMoreNow] Thanks for the update. How do I mark the OP deal expired or no longer available?
[cnut] Others might have some luck but I tried and that’s what they said. 🥲
…after being on the chat for about an hour.
[SpendMoreNow] Ok. I will add your post in main deal text.
[rdymarsh] Can you legends recommend me a decent budgetish tv similar to this one in 98"?
It's for a wall that is 3.6m wide and we'll be viewing it from about 4.5m away.
Mostly for general stuff like movies and AFL.
Not interested in the best of the best - just something solid.
[barginhunter82] Just got a 75 C8L matched with Powerland for 2180 with free delivery and then used the $500 coupon. Total paid 1680
